I will give you 2000 rupees, will you come on video call?

model_flags.translation: Now, if we want to see your video call, we have to pay 200 rupees.
model_flags.excerpt: Ippo oru 200 rupay illa pay pannittu ungal video call ah paakanum naanga.

model_flags.translation: We are just talking, we will talk on a normal call.
model_flags.excerpt: Summa pesrana normal call ah pesuvom.

model_flags.translation: For sex, you did [something] to bring out the sex power.

model_flags.translation: Now, doing it has money/cost.
model_flags.excerpt: இனி பண்றது காசு இருக்கு.

model_flags.translation: Are you thin or fat?

model_flags.translation: What size do you wear?
model_flags.excerpt: என்ன சைஸ் போடுறீங்க?

model_flags.translation: Tell me, you looked good. If a mood comes, a girl will play this game. If that girl plays, forgive me.

model_flags.translation: Please give your number.
model_flags.excerpt: Long number thareengala please.

model_flags.translation: Is it 2000 rupees for you? In video?
model_flags.excerpt: உங்களுக்கு 2000 ரூபா ஆகுதா? வீடியோலயா?

model_flags.translation: If you want to give 2000, where are you?

model_flags.translation: Tell me your number, I will give you my number.
model_flags.excerpt: Unga number kodranna solunga, naan number kodukken.

model_flags.translation: Tell me if you are fully available for a video call, I will prepare for you. 2000.
model_flags.excerpt: Nee video call la full ah varreenaa solunga, naan ungalukku ready pandren. 2000.

model_flags.translation: Just for money, for money to come. For romance, for money to come.
model_flags.excerpt: சும்மா பேசம் சாலியா பேசம் வரத. ரொமான்சா பேசம் வரத.

model_flags.translation: If you show only above [the waist/upper body], 500. Okay?

model_flags.translation: First pay, I'll come.
model_flags.excerpt: ஃபர்ஸ்ட் பே பண்ணுங்க நான் காம.

model_flags.translation: I will come to look below. Advantage is below.

model_flags.translation: Only above I am. I only want to show myself.
model_flags.excerpt: Meela mattum naan. Naan mattum naan venam kamikranu varan.

model_flags.translation: Tell me your phone number, I will give the number.
model_flags.excerpt: En phone number solunga naan number kodukuren.

model_flags.translation: If I call you on the phone one day, give me the number.
model_flags.excerpt: Na one day pannittu namak phone adikkuradha number.
